title: Portrait Photo Into Story Frame
tests: Tests creating a vertical story from a square portrait without clipping the person or distorting the photo.

faults.what: The image is tightly cropped at both sides, cutting off substantial shoulder areas and some outer curls visible in the source, despite the explicit request to keep all hair and shoulders.

judge.summary: The output achieves a 9:16 story frame but crops away shoulders and outer curls instead of preserving the full portrait.

must_haves.item: The delivered image has a 9:16 vertical frame.
must_haves.why: The displayed output has the requested tall 9:16 proportions.

must_haves.item: The sharp foreground portrait shows the same woman, curly hair and sweater as the attachment.
must_haves.why: The face, curls and gray knit sweater match the source.

must_haves.item: No hair or shoulder area visible in the source is lost.
must_haves.why: Both shoulders are substantially cropped, and outer curls are cut off at the side edges.

must_haves.item: The portrait is not stretched or squeezed.
must_haves.why: The portrait appears proportionally enlarged and cropped, without visible distortion.

must_haves.item: Any added background space uses a blurred version of the source photo, with no text.
must_haves.why: No added background space is visible, so the conditional blur requirement does not apply; no text appears.
